اقترحت (form VIII)

# اِقْتَرَحْتَ (iqtaraḥta) /iq.ta.raħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اِقْتَرَحْتِ (iqtaraḥti) /iq.ta.raħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اِقْتَرَحَتْ (iqtaraḥat) /iq.ta.ra.ħat/: third-perso
